title: California PERB Decision No. 2398H
summary: * * * CLARIFIED by Regents of the University of California (2025) PERB Order No. Ad-525-H * * * Description: The complaint alleged that the Regents of the University of California (UC) repudiated the agreement between it and University Council-AFT (UC-AFT) regarding the classification of lecturers and adjunct professors when UC classified part-time instructors as non-bargaining unit adjunct professors. Disposition: The Board held that UC unlawfully repudiated the agreement between it and UC-AFT regarding the classification of lecturers and adjunct professors by failing to classify as lecturers part-time instructors at the UCLA School of Law where their duties consisted only of teaching, and not research.
